source.name: National Wastewater Drug Monitoring Program
source.notes: State-level annual estimated consumption (kg/year). Site-level data exists but is not extractable from the public PDF. Capital/regional averages exist as charts only. NSW has 26 sample sites covering ~70% of population.

methylamphetamine.notes: At record levels. Higher consumption in regional NSW than Sydney across all 3 Y9 reporting periods.

cocaine.notes: At record levels. Sydney sites + a regional NSW site had consistently high consumption.

mdma.notes: Sydney sites had highest capital-city MDMA; regional NSW sites had highest regional MDMA in Australia.

heroin.notes: Sydney + regional NSW sites had highest heroin consumption in Australia. Regional NSW heroin consumption far higher than regional Victoria.

siteHighlights.fentanyl: Site 81 (regional NSW) consistently had the highest fentanyl consumption in Australia, by some margin.
siteHighlights.oxycodone: Regional NSW sites had relatively high oxycodone consumption (elevated regional vs capital).
siteHighlights.nicotine: A regional NSW site had the highest regional nicotine consumption in Australia.
